description: jEULYNX and railway point subsystem simulator provides jEULYNX Java test-suite generation and an extended simulator for an EULYNX railway point subsystem. The provider is Djurre van der Wal, Marcus Gerhold, Arend Rensink and Marielle Stoelinga. Geographical and temporal coverage: The 2025 study software includes JVM 18+ code, Windows 10/11 simulator binaries and reproduction instructions. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is MIT. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
